note: Svalbard and Jan Mayen, read 2026-10-31. Both are part of the Kingdom of Norway (the Governor of Svalbard's page on its laws). The Svalbard Act (svalbardloven, LOV-1925-07-17-11), s. 2, which puts Norwegian private, criminal and procedural law in force there, and the Jan Mayen Act are on Lovdata, which refuses this client (405), and archive.org's snapshots of the Svalbard Act (4 August 2026), the Guardianship Act (15 May 2026) and the Working Environment Act (17 October 2026) couldn't be fetched (connections closed, ten tries each); so that s. 2 brings the Guardianship Act in is my reading, from its well-known terms, not a text read today. Majority: the guardianship authorities' site (vergemal.no, the State Administrators and the Civil Affairs Authority) says a person of 18 is of age (myndig), from the Guardianship Act (vergemålsloven, LOV-2010-03-26-9) as Norwegian private law; held as 18. Work: the Storting's labour and social affairs committee (Innst. 145 L (2024-2025), on applying the general application act to Svalbard) records that the Labour Inspection Authority already supervises the Working Environment Act on Svalbard; so the Act's rules for young workers are held to apply there (my reading: the regulations that adapt the Act for Svalbard weren't read, Lovdata refusing). The Authority (arbeidstilsynet.no) says the main rule is no work under 15; light work from 13 and school programmes from 14 aren't held; a performer in cultural, artistic, sports or advertising work under 15, or still in lower secondary school, needs the Authority's prior consent (forhåndssamtykke), which the employer applies for, and the age limit of 13 doesn't apply to it, so no permitFrom. Service: the Armed Forces (forsvaret.no) say Norwegian citizens of 19 to 44 who qualify are liable in peacetime, women born in 1997 or later as men are, with 12 months of initial service (førstegongsteneste) of a 19-month duty; the duty follows citizenship, so it binds Norwegian citizens living on Svalbard (my reading; the Svalbard Treaty's bar on bases doesn't touch it), and not the archipelago's many foreign residents, which the form doesn't distinguish. The Armed Forces decide who qualifies, so most of a year group isn't called (not held); the civil defence duty (18 to 55) isn't held.

sources.title: Arbeidstilsynet: Ungdom i arbeid (arbeidstilsynet.no)
sources.said: Hovedregelen er at du som er under 15 år, ikke har lov til å arbeide. ... Aldersgrensa på 13 år gjelder heller ikke dersom du skal opptre i ... Dersom du skal opptre i kulturelt, kunstnerisk, sportslig eller reklamemessig arbeid og er under 15 år eller går på ungdomsskolen, må arbeidsgiveren din søke Arbeidstilsynet om forhåndssamtykke ... Har du fylt 15 år og er ferdig med ungdomsskolen, kan du ha arbeid

sources.title: Forsvaret: Verneplikt (forsvaret.no)
sources.said: I fredstid er norske statsborgarar mellom 19 og 44 år, som er kvalifiserte til teneste, vernepliktige. ... Verneplikta gjeld berre for kvinner fødde i 1997 eller seinare. ... har gjennomført 12 månader førstegongsteneste
